rationale: Accepted by the independent requirements review at document cycle 3 (author claude-opus-5-5, reviewer codex gpt-6.1-sol; the author found nothing blocking). INPUT-1 binds RG-REQ-011-L13 (revision 2) for STATE-ROOT-RELATIVE-REPO-ROOT-1: every working-tree reader takes the registry canonical_path through one checked lookup in a new module daemon-runtime/src/repo_root.rs; the db-relative helpers and EnrichmentStoragePort::get_repo_root are deleted; the orient decorator carries the root check result and is built for every orient request with a READY epoch; the document read is a connection-free storage function; an unreachable root is named (repo root not found) and never rendered as an absence; docs JSON repo_path is absolute; no migration and no eager rewrite. SRR-C03 is proven by the operator on HEAD (fails at the defect; passes steps 3-5 on simulated-fixed output). Decisions: D-SRR-ROOTPATH-1 (human, A) and D-SRR-SCOPE-1 (operator, A, overridable by the human), each with an operator Correction 1. Cycles 1-2 were operator-text corrections (one decision, SRR-ORIENT-BARE-BRANCH, resolved A by the operator in agreement with both reviews); cycle 3 accepted.
